# proxmox_access_ticket (Data Source)

Authenticates through `POST /access/ticket` and exposes the ticket, CSRF token, and cluster name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_access_ticket" "root" {
  username = "root@pam"
  password = var.proxmox_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `username` (String)

### Optional

- `new_format` (Boolean)
- `otp` (String, Sensitive)
- `path` (String)
- `privs` (String)
- `realm` (String)
- `tfa_challenge` (String, Sensitive)

### Read-Only

- `clustername` (String)
- `csrf_token` (String, Sensitive)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ticket` (String, Sensitive)
